description: This file implements a memory search function `gitmemmem`, which searches for a substring within a memory buffer, similar to `memmem`.

methods.name: void * gitmemmem(const void * haystack,size_t haystack_len,const void * needle,size_t needle_len)
methods.description: Searches for the first occurrence of a byte sequence (`needle`) within another byte sequence (`haystack`), both specified by pointers and lengths.
